title: youtube-live-extract tests do not pin exact-host matching: suffix-lookalike hosts (evilyoutube.com, evilyoutu.be) are untested, so host.endsWith(...) survives
evidence: Mutation on HEAD ab64b275: replacing `host === "youtu.be"` with `host.endsWith("youtu.be")`, and the youtube.com triple with `host.endsWith("youtube.com")`, left youtube-live-extract.test.ts green (7/7 pass). The code itself is correct: probe of https://evilyoutube.com/live/abcDEF12345 returns undefined. Only the youtube.com.evil prefix-lookalike is in the test list.
fix_direction: Add to the hostile list: https://evilyoutube.com/live/<id>, https://evilyoutu.be/<id>, https://notyoutu.be/<id>; verify inside the unit that wires resolveYoutubeLive (verify-in-next-unit, medium).
